categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies coin locking logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where upgrading a non-persistent coin lock to a persistent lock fails to update the in-memory persistence flag, causing spent coins to retain stale database lock records across restarts. While this creates a persistent wallet state inconsistency, the failure path requires a specific lock upgrade sequence and does not risk fund loss.
